# TRAINING_HISTORY.md -- every saved training run

*Generated by `tools/training_history.py` from every sweep report, log and job file under `models/` and `results/` (nothing sampled, nothing typed by hand). It is the answer to "how did the numbers get here and what did each run cost". The current numbers are in [REPORT.md](REPORT.md); where each file lives is in [DATA_MAP.md](DATA_MAP.md).*

## How to read the trend

- The first classifier sweep (2026-10-14, 119 recordings from 1 person) scored **100.0 %**; the latest (2026-10-22, 211 recordings, 5 people, person held out) scores **69.5 %** (the deployed 4-model vote). The drop is not the models getting worse: with one person and one take per gesture the score measured which block of signal a window came from (EDA.md), and it stopped doing so once people could be held out.
- 18 of the 29 sweeps are person-held-out; their best per-window scores run from 56.5 % to 86.8 %. Those sweeps also differ in people (2 to 5), calibration and window length, so they are a history, not a controlled comparison.
- The `contrast` column is the same model scored with recordings (not people) held out. The gap between it and the person-held-out score is how much of a score is the wearer rather than the gesture.

## 3. Long runs and what they cost

| run | items | wall time | state | log |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ML ablation (3 seeds) | 99 | 19 min |  | `results/ablation/ml/log.txt` |
| NN ablation (3 seeds) | 21 | 36 min |  | `results/ablation/nn/log.txt` |
| ML ablation without Barbora | 72 | 7 min |  | `results/ablation_without_barbora/ml/log.txt` |
| NN ablation without Barbora | 21 | 32 min |  | `results/ablation_without_barbora/nn/log.txt` |
| zoo evaluation and fits | -- | 69 min |  | `results/zoo_eval/log.txt` |
| zoo trained without Barbora | -- | 16 min |  | `results/zoo_eval_without_barbora/log.txt` |
| combination search, ML (20261022-003918) | 592 of 592 | 10.6 h | done | `models\comb_test\20261022-003918\state_ml.json` |
| combination search, NN (20261022-003918) | 12 of 34 | 44 min | frozen | `models\comb_test\20261022-003918\state_nn.json` |
| background job ml (20261022-114323) | -- | 6 s | cancelled | `models\jobs\20261022-114323_ml_cf030d\status.json` |
| background job ml (20261022-114727) | -- | 3 min | finished | `models\jobs\20261022-114727_ml_963b64\status.json` |
| background job ml (20261022-121311) | -- | 2 min | finished | `models\jobs\20261022-121311_ml_f2c30d\status.json` |

Times are wall-clock on the i5-9300H / GTX 1650 machine, with other work often running at the same time. The combination search's NN half was stopped by choice after 12 of 34 configurations (GRU 0.7 s kept); the ML half ran all 592 combinations (about 10.6 h).
